# Chapter 2 — 我每天六点起床 (I Get Up at Six Every Day)

Source: HSK Standard Course 2, scanned source pages 029–036 (printed pages 9–16). Vocabulary transcribed from the New Words lists on source pages 030–031 (printed pages 10–11). Character instruction transcribed from source pages 035–036 (printed pages 15–16).

## Characters Section

The textbook’s Characters instruction on printed pages 14–15 teaches or presents the following items separately from the New Words list:

- **Stroke forms (p. 14):** 横撇弯钩 (horizontal–left-falling–curved hook) and 横折折撇 (horizontal–turning–double-turning–left-falling). Example characters shown: **队** (duì, team), **阵** (zhèn, battle array), **及** (jí, to reach; and), **级** (jí, level; grade).
- **Single-component characters (p. 15):** **生** (shēng; meanings include to get/be born, to live) and **高** (gāo, tall/high), with character-origin and writing practice.
- **Radicals (p. 15):** **⺮ / 竹字头** (bamboo radical; examples **篮** lán, basket; **笔** bǐ, pen) and **欠** (欠字旁; associated with mouth movements; examples **歌** gē, song; **吹** chuī, to blow).
